_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "plate_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "make" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "chassis_number" TEXT NULL, "last_odometer" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "services" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES item_categories (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'قطعة', "cost_price" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sale_price" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "min_quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "movement_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "ref_id" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_invoices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "supplier_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "supplier_invoice_number" TEXT NULL, "invoice_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_invoice_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "purchase_invoice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id), "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_orders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "order_number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "vehicle_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id), "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "odometer" INTEGER NULL, "complaint" TEXT NULL, "mechanic_name" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "cancellation_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "closed_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_order_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "work_order_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES work_orders (id), "line_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "service_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES services (id), "item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES items (id), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_price" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "work_order_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES work_orders (id), "customer_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NULL, "cancellation_reason" TEXT NULL, "issued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id), "line_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "service_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES services (id), "item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES items (id), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_price" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_counts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "count_number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "finalized_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_count_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "stock_count_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_counts (id), "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "system_qty" REAL NOT NULL, "counted_qty" REAL NULL, "difference" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
